classification: Prospective remediation study informed by archived results; separate from every historical statistical family

matched_controls.positive_evidence: passive .5 or signed receipt 1; proofs excluded from matched-arm credit
matched_controls.late_positive_evidence: accepted for both matched rules after successful own ACK until slot reuse
matched_controls.negative_rule: one expected-weight failure increment on expiry without positive evidence when enabled

reference_scope: Original active semantics retained as reference, not a matched negative-rule intervention

statistical_plan.unit: Independent geometry block; average the two radio seeds and paired permutations/attacker positions within each block
statistical_plan.primary_endpoint: Post-onset unique sink delivery fraction in attacked runs
statistical_plan.primary_contrasts: negative-update main effect, proof-generation main effect, difference-in-differences interaction; each at timing 0 and 1
statistical_plan.multiplicity: One 6-contrast Holm family for primary delivery; separate 6-contrast families for critical failure and transmit-state seconds
statistical_plan.CI: Pointwise paired cluster bootstrap over 12 geometry blocks, 20000 draws, RNG 951019
statistical_plan.tests: Two-sided exhaustive sign-flip over 12 block differences, 4096 assignments, conditional on symmetric block effects; no claim of randomized treatment assignment
statistical_plan.secondary: Benign summaries, active-reference contrasts, adaptation, onset/channel/checkpoint interactions descriptive/exploratory, not pooled confirmatory tests
statistical_plan.practical_margin: No noninferiority or equivalence claim; report effects and pointwise intervals without invented deployment margins
statistical_plan.adaptation: First three consecutive safe source selections after attack onset; report right censoring and recovery within 20 packet opportunities
statistical_plan.limits: Checkpoint/onset/channel are balanced block factors, not fully crossed within each geometry. Three retained checkpoints and a narrow geometry family do not identify a universal threshold.

timing_scope: Native host execution or illustrative per-packet scheduled delays; no serial CPU service/physical calibration
energy_scope: Energest transmit/listen seconds only; no measured joules
security_scope: Public fixture-key tests; no deployment confidentiality/protected key storage claim
execution_policy: Technical preflight excluded. Retain all declared cases and failures; no outcome-based retries/exclusions. Stop incomplete on infrastructure/audit failures.
